page_title: GET 0-0 VIL | Getafe v Villarreal 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Mateo Busquets Ferrer has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90+1' One of the Villarreal players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' 7:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
87' Carles Alena (Getafe) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Mateo Busquets Ferrer stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
86' Villarreal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
83' Substitution. Aissa Mandi (Villarreal) replaces Yeremy Pino.
82' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' That's the end of the game for Diego Rico, who is replaced by Carles Alena (Getafe).
82' The referee signals a substitution. Choco Lozano (Getafe) is brought on as a substitute for Borja Mayoral.
82' Here is a change. Damian Suarez is going off and Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Fabrizio Angileri (Getafe).

81' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time shot towards the bottom right corner from a promising distance, but Filip Jorgensen denies him. The referee signals a corner kick to Getafe.
79' Diego Rico (Getafe) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
78' Getafe get a corner.

77' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) leaps like a salmon to meet a lofted ball into the box, but his header from near the penalty spot fizzes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
74' What was Kiko (Villarreal) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
73' Problems for Pacheta as Juan Foyth is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) replaces him.
71' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul.
69' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
68' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) perfectly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate enough and the ball goes a few inches over the bar!
67' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets Ferrer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
67' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.

65' Stefan Mitrovic (Getafe) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
64' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) failed to beat Filip Jorgensen, who expertly stopped his header from the centre of the box towards the roof of the net after a rebound.
62' Filip Jorgensen (Villarreal) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
61' That will be all from Alexander Sorloth who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal).
61' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches over the crossbar.
60' None of the Villarreal players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

60' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Villarreal will take a corner kick.
59' The foul by Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) was seen by Mateo Busquets Ferrer who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
56' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
55' The attendance is 11255.
54' Corner kick. Villarreal will have an opportunity.
53' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer had an easy-decision to make.

49' Great solo effort from Mason Greenwood (Getafe)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
48' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Pacheta probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal). He is replaced by Alberto Moreno.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) is replaced by Kiko.
46' Half-time substitution. Jose Bordalas Jimenez decided to make a change. Jaime Mata (Getafe) is replaced by Juanmi Latasa.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives a chance to Mason Greenwood and Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) is off.
46' Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.

45+2' That's unlucky! Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
43' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
42' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 10:5.
40' Filip Jorgensen (Villarreal) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
39' Filip Jorgensen (Villarreal) picks up an injury.
38' Diego Rico (Getafe) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Filip Jorgensen, who smothers the ball.
37' Jaime Mata (Getafe) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
35' Damian Suarez (Getafe) sends a long ball in, but Filip Jorgensen comfortably gathers the ball.
32' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing.

32' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but Filip Jorgensen is alert and denies him with a nice save. The linesman makes the right call and Getafe will have a corner.
30' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
29' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for an infringement.
27' Diego Rico (Getafe) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
25' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle after Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
23' He’s off! Alex Baena (Villarreal) gets his marching orders from referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer after the VAR review.

23' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Alex Baena (Villarreal) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
22' Stefan Mitrovic (Getafe) tackles a bit over-zealously and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul.
20' PENALTY APPEAL by Villarreal, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
19' Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

17' The corner lands on the head of Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) in the middle of the box and he tries to guide his header into the far right corner, but it's misjudged and goes well wide of the right post.
16' The linesman points to the corner flag, Getafe are going to take it.

16' Jaime Mata (Getafe) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom left corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Filip Jorgensen. What a save! The ball is out of play. Getafe will have a chance to score from a corner.
16' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Filip Jorgensen sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
14' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
10' Djene (Getafe) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
7' Damian Suarez (Getafe) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
6' The linesman signals that Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
6' The free kick from close range, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
4' Getafe force their opponents to concede a corner.

4' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Getafe force a corner. They send men into the box.
1' Matteo Gabbia (Villarreal) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Getafe will have the kick-off.
Mateo Busquets Ferrer was nominated as the referee for this game.
